property_summary: For any admissible configuration, c.oracle() must return exactly the oracle contract address that was configured at initialization (a non-zero address with code); the mutant always returns address(0), breaking the rule for every successfully initialized oracle.
change_summary: Return the zero address instead of the stored oracle address.
mutated_unit_code: function oracle() public view returns (IOracleProvider) { return IOracleProvider(address(0)); }
